slides.headline: RESEARCHERS SPENT $70,000 TO FIND WHAT'S INSIDE YOUR LG TV
slides.body: In standby, your LG TV logs plain-text transcripts of nearby conversations and maps every other device in your home, then ships it all to LG's ad arm. Unplug the internet and it saves those files locally until you reconnect. 216 million of these TVs are sitting in living rooms right now

slides.headline: ANTHROPIC MAPPED HOW AI RESHAPES YOUR JOB AND PAY BY 2030
slides.body: Anthropic's economics team built a model showing what AI does to growth, jobs, and wages through 2030, then ran the same questions past more than 10,000 Americans. You can step through their scenarios yourself and see whether your predictions match everyone else's

slides.headline: SPIEGEL AND THIEL ARE HIDING THEIR KIDS FROM THEIR OWN APPS
slides.body: A Fortune report found tech billionaires are quietly shielding their own children from the products that made them rich. Evan Spiegel of Snapchat and Peter Thiel of PayPal are both called out by name

slides.headline: THE MOVIE SAM ALTMAN TRIED TO KILL OPENS CHRISTMAS DAY
slides.body: When Amazon Studios was investing in OpenAI, Altman pressured them to pull a film called 'Artificial', and they dropped it. Now it opens in cinemas on Christmas Day regardless

slides.headline: AN ANTHROPIC RESEARCHER QUIT AND CALLED THEIR AI AN EXTINCTION THREAT
slides.body: Researcher Jacob Coxon quit this week, writing that the company and OpenAI are 'gambling with our lives' in the race toward superintelligence. This is the same company that last raised at a confirmed $61.5 billion private valuation

slides.headline: NASA'S CHIEF WANTS AI DATA CENTERS LAUNCHED INTO ORBIT
slides.body: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman backed SpaceX's plan to put AI computing clusters in orbit, pointing to the sun as a free power source. 'You never want to bet against Elon Musk,' he said
